description: Unauthorized S3 Bucket Access via Misconfigured Public Access The S3 bucket hosting the static website has publicReadAccess enabled and BlockPublicAccess settings disabled to allow website hosting. Without proper bucket policies and origin access controls, this could allow unauthorized access to website content. An attacker could bypass CloudFront and directly access the S3 bucket URL to retrieve website content or potentially upload malicious content if write permissions are not properly restricted.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement CloudFront Origin Access Identity (OAI) for S3 bucket access
recommendation: Enhance S3 bucket security configuration

description: Insecure Data Processing Pipeline The data processing pipeline accepts raw data uploads, processes them through Lambda functions, and stores results in S3. Without proper validation and sanitization, malicious data could lead to injection attacks or data leakage. An attacker could upload specially crafted data that contains malicious code or sensitive information, which could be executed during processing or exposed in visualizations.
references: recommendation: Implement comprehensive data validation and sanitization
recommendation: Enhance data processing security controls

description: Insufficient API Security Controls The API Gateway is configured with CORS allowing all origins and methods, and lacks proper authentication mechanisms. While it uses IAM for service-to-service communication, user authentication is not properly implemented. An attacker could forge requests to the API endpoints, bypassing intended access controls and potentially accessing or modifying sensitive data.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material
recommendation: Implement proper API authentication and authorization
